projects.name: Instagram Comments Filtering
projects.description:
Machine Learning-Powered Offensive Language Detection

Instagram Comments Filtering is a browser extension backed by a machine learning service, designed to make Instagram comment sections safer and more comfortable to browse. It analyzes user comments, identifies potentially harmful language, and visually obscures comments classified as offensive while leaving other comments unchanged.

The system consists of a Chrome extension integrated with a Python Flask REST API. It uses a text-classification model trained on the Davidson Hate Speech and Offensive Language Dataset to categorize comments into three classes: hate speech, offensive language, and neither. The API preprocesses incoming text using a TF-IDF vectorizer and returns classification predictions, which the browser extension uses to determine which comments should be visually obscured.

Key Features:
- Chrome Extension: Integrates with Instagram to analyze comments directly within the browser.
- Machine Learning Classification: Identifies hate speech, offensive language, and non-offensive text.
- Flask REST API: Provides a prediction endpoint for processing comment text and returning classification results.
- NLP and Text Processing: Uses TF-IDF vectorization and a scikit-learn classification pipeline for text analysis.
- Dynamic Comment Monitoring: Periodically scans Instagram comment sections to detect newly loaded comments.
- Visual Content Filtering: Automatically obscures comments identified as offensive while preserving the visibility of other comments.
- Model Exploration: Explores an LSTM-based deep learning approach alongside scikit-learn classification models.

Technical Overview:
The project combines a JavaScript-based Chrome extension with a Python Flask API to deliver real-time-style comment classification and filtering. The backend handles text preprocessing and machine learning predictions, while the extension monitors Instagram's comment section and applies visual filtering based on the API responses. The classification models are trained using the Davidson dataset, with TF-IDF feature extraction supporting the machine learning pipeline.

Tech Stack: Python, Flask, scikit-learn, TF-IDF, NLP, JavaScript, Chrome Extension APIs, Davidson Hate Speech and Offensive Language Dataset.

projects.name: CLARA — AI-Powered Recruitment and Candidate Assessment Platform
projects.description:
CLARA — AI-Powered Recruitment and Candidate Matching Platform

CLARA is an intelligent recruitment platform designed to streamline applicant screening and help hiring teams evaluate how well candidates match specific job requirements. It integrates with multiple Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), processes resumes and job descriptions, and generates structured candidate profiles, fit scores, and requirement-level match insights to support more informed hiring decisions.

The platform is built around three cooperating microservices: API, ATS, and AI. API handles the central platform APIs and business workflows, including account and partner management, jobs, applications, dashboards, notifications, and subscription functionality. ATS manages integrations with external recruiting systems, enabling recruitment data synchronization and standardized communication with platforms such as Greenhouse, Lever, SmartRecruiters, Jobvite, Teamtailor, Workable, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, ADP Workforce Now, Pinpoint, and Oracle Recruiting. AI handles document processing and candidate assessments by extracting structured information from resumes and job descriptions, analyzing candidate qualifications, and calculating weighted fit scores across skills, experience, and education.

Together, these services provide an end-to-end recruitment workflow, from importing candidate information and processing documents to generating match results and delivering actionable screening insights to hiring teams. The platform also supports sending selected candidate information, including tags, comments, and custom-field data, back to connected ATS platforms. Background workers manage resource-intensive document processing and application workflows asynchronously.

Key Features:
- ATS Integrations: Connect with multiple recruiting platforms, synchronize recruitment data, and support standardized ATS communication.
- Resume and Job Description Parsing: Extract structured information and relevant attributes from candidate resumes and job descriptions.
- AI-Powered Candidate Matching: Evaluate candidate suitability against job requirements using skills, experience, and education.
- Weighted Fit Scoring: Calculate candidate fit scores with configurable weighting across different job requirements.
- Requirement-Level Analysis: Provide detailed match breakdowns highlighting candidate strengths and potential gaps.
- Application Summaries: Generate structured candidate and application summaries to support recruiter decision-making.
- Follow-Up Questions: Generate relevant questions to gather additional information during candidate assessments.
- Candidate Assessments: Process candidate responses and provide additional evaluation insights.
- Recruitment Management: Support account, partner, job, application, dashboard, notification, and subscription workflows.
- Asynchronous Processing: Use background workers to handle long-running document processing and application-related tasks efficiently.
- ATS Data Synchronization: Return supported candidate tags, comments, and custom-field information to connected recruiting systems.

Technical Overview:
The platform follows a microservices architecture consisting of three cooperating Python services. API uses Django REST Framework to implement the central platform APIs and business logic, while ATS and AI use Flask for ATS integrations and document processing, respectively. Celery and Redis support asynchronous task execution and background processing. PostgreSQL and MongoDB handle application and document-related data, while Azure Blob Storage provides document storage. LangChain-based LLM integrations support intelligent document analysis, candidate evaluation, and AI-assisted recruitment workflows.

Tech Stack: Python, Django REST Framework, Flask, Celery, Redis, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Blob Storage, LangChain, LLM Integrations, Microservices Architecture.

projects.name: Sentimantle — Hotel Review Intelligence Platform
projects.description:
Sentimantle — Hotel Review Intelligence Platform

Sentimantle is a review analytics platform that helps hospitality businesses understand guest feedback and turn it into actionable insights. It brings hotel review data together in reports that show how guests feel about specific aspects of their stay, such as cleanliness, location, rooms, service, and value, and how that sentiment changes over time.

Instead of relying only on overall ratings, teams can explore positive and negative feedback by topic, compare properties, and identify recurring strengths or concerns. Sentimantle includes reporting and visualization features such as sentiment timelines, aspect analysis, word clouds, property maps, and hotel benchmarks. Users can organize properties and reports, while alerts and task boards help teams track follow-up work.

Key Capabilities:
- Aspect-based Review Analysis: Explore guest sentiment across hotel attributes, not just overall scores.
- Interactive Reporting: Filter reports by property and date range, and review sentiment trends over time.
- Property Comparison: Benchmark hotels and compare performance across selected aspects.
- Visual Exploration: Use word clouds, maps, timelines, and other report views to identify patterns.
- Review and Property Management: Manage hotel, review, and aspect data through administrative tools.
- Team Workflows: Organize properties into groups and coordinate follow-up with alerts and task boards.
- Account Management: Support user and administrator accounts, including authentication and email verification.

Technology Stack:
The platform is built using Python and Flask REST APIs, backed by a MySQL database. It includes complex SQL queries, database views, stored procedures, and reporting and data-management functionality. The project follows a microservices architecture consisting of three cooperating services, with JWT-based authentication and authorization, file upload and download capabilities, and administrative functionality.

projects.name: OCR AWS Lambda
projects.description: Developed a robust OCR solution in Python using AWS services like Lambda, S3, Docker, and ECR. The goal was to extract text from PDFs in S3 buckets for downstream processing. A Lambda function triggered by new PDF uploads used a custom Docker container in ECR with OCR libraries to extract text with high accuracy. The results were stored in another S3 bucket or integrated with other AWS services for further processing, all within an automated workflow, reducing manual intervention and processing time.

projects.name: AWS Lambda REST API
projects.description: Developed a Flask-based REST API and utilized AWS Lambda with Amazon API Gateway for deployment, all while seamlessly integrating a MySQL database. API had JWT authentication. This architecture resulted in a dynamic API that efficiently managed user interactions. By combining Flask flexibility with AWS Lambda serverless power and API Gateway management capabilities, I created a high-performance solution that showcased my skills in web development and cloud integration.

projects.name: Azure Functions REST API
projects.description: Designed and developed a robust system using Flask to create a RESTful API, seamlessly connected to a MySQL database. The unique aspect of this project was its integration with Azure Functions, enabling automatic scaling and event-driven execution. This combination of Flask, MySQL, and Azure Functions delivered a scalable, high-performing solution. The project showcased my expertise in web development and leveraging cloud services for enhanced functionality.

projects.name: El-tejarah
projects.description:
El-tejarah — Multi-Vendor E-commerce Marketplace

El-tejarah is a multi-vendor e-commerce platform designed to connect customers with independent sellers through a centralized online marketplace. It provides dedicated interfaces for customers, sellers, and administrators, enabling seamless product discovery, marketplace management, and online transactions through an integrated storefront and backend API.

The platform offers customers a comprehensive shopping experience, allowing them to browse products by category or seller, search and sort listings, explore product details, and use shopping features such as a cart, wishlist, and product comparison. It also supports customer account management, order history, invoice generation, and a complete checkout workflow.

Sellers have access to dedicated dashboards for managing product listings, monitoring orders, and tracking sales and earnings. Administrators can oversee marketplace operations by managing vendors, customers, products, categories, and promotional content, as well as monitoring orders and transactions. The backend API handles core marketplace operations, while MySQL stores essential application data, including products, customers, vendors, invoices, and order statuses.

Key Features:
- Customer Storefront: Browse products, explore sellers, and discover items across different categories.
- Product Discovery: Search products, filter by category, and sort listings by price.
- Shopping Experience: Implement shopping cart, wishlist, and product comparison functionality.
- Customer Management: Support customer accounts, order history, checkout, and invoice management.
- Seller Dashboard: Enable sellers to manage product listings and monitor incoming orders.
- Sales and Earnings Tracking: Provide sellers with insights into sales performance and earnings.
- Administration Dashboard: Manage marketplace products, vendors, customers, and categories.
- Order and Transaction Management: Track orders, transaction records, and order statuses.
- Product and Promotion Management: Support product sales and promotional marketplace content.

Technical Overview:
The platform is developed using Angular and TypeScript on the frontend, with Bootstrap for responsive UI components. The backend is built using Python, Flask, and Flask-RESTful, providing API functionality for customer, seller, and administrative operations. MySQL serves as the primary relational database, with SQLAlchemy and MySQL Connector handling database interactions and data persistence. The application follows a multi-role marketplace architecture that brings customer shopping, seller operations, and administrative management together within a unified e-commerce ecosystem.

Tech Stack: Angular, TypeScript, Bootstrap, Python, Flask, Flask-RESTful, MySQL, SQLAlchemy, MySQL Connector.

projects.name: WebSocket Integration — Real-Time Data Synchronization & Notifications
projects.description:
Implemented WebSocket-based communication to establish persistent, bidirectional connections between backend services and client applications. This enables real-time data synchronization, automatic updates, and instant notifications without requiring clients to repeatedly poll the server.

Key Capabilities:
- Real-Time Data Updates: Periodically retrieve and broadcast the latest database changes to connected clients, keeping application data synchronized.
- Instant Notifications: Automatically notify connected clients whenever new records or relevant data are added to the database.
- Persistent Connections: Maintain WebSocket connections for continuous communication between the server and clients.
- Task Cancellation & Management: Ensure only the latest incoming request is processed by canceling previously running tasks before initiating new ones.
- Asynchronous Processing: Handle concurrent connections and background operations efficiently without blocking other application activities.
- Data Synchronization: Deliver updated information to clients as soon as changes occur, improving consistency across connected sessions.
- Resource Optimization: Prevent redundant processing and unnecessary background operations by managing active tasks and replacing outdated requests.

Technical Overview:
Developed a real-time communication mechanism using WebSockets to synchronize database-driven information with connected clients. Integrated asynchronous task management to handle periodic updates, event-triggered notifications, and request cancellation. This approach improves responsiveness, reduces unnecessary client-server requests, and ensures users receive the most relevant and up-to-date information.

projects.name: Gift Marketplace
projects.description:
Product Discovery and Gift Recommendation Platform

Gift Marketplace is a product discovery platform designed to help shoppers explore products from multiple retailers and find suitable gifts for different occasions. It brings product information, including images, descriptions, prices, ratings, availability, categories, and retailer links, into a centralized and searchable catalog.

The platform provides a Flask REST API for product discovery, featuring Elasticsearch-powered search suggestions, category and occasion-based filtering, price sorting, and paginated product listings. Users can register and authenticate to access personalized features, including saving products to favorites and comparing selected products. The platform also provides insights into recent searches, popular and trending categories, and occasion-specific gift recommendations for birthdays, anniversaries, and weddings.

Key Features:
- Product Search: Implement Elasticsearch-powered product search with autocomplete-style suggestions.
- Advanced Filtering: Filter products by categories, product types, occasions, and price order.
- Product Catalog: Retrieve and browse paginated product listings with detailed product information.
- User Authentication: Support user registration, login, token refresh, and logout using JWT authentication.
- Personalized Favorites: Allow registered users to save and manage favorite products, with guest access to product lookup functionality.
- Product Comparison: Provide product information for comparing selected items side by side.
- Search Insights: Track recent searches and provide popular and trending category information.
- Occasion-Based Discovery: Support gift exploration and recommendations for birthdays, anniversaries, and weddings.

Technical Overview:
The backend is developed using Python, Flask, and Flask-RESTful, with MySQL managing product catalog and user-related data. Elasticsearch powers product search, autocomplete suggestions, and category aggregations, enabling efficient product discovery and filtering. JWT-based authentication secures user-specific functionality, including favorites and account management. The application organizes its API functionality into dedicated product, user, and API resource modules, supported by a structured database schema for product attributes and categories.

Tech Stack: Python, Flask, Flask-RESTful, MySQL, Elasticsearch, JWT Authentication.

projects.name: Charge Guard
projects.description:
Snowflake-Powered Chargeback & Dispute Analytics

Charge Guard is a data-driven analytics platform designed to monitor and analyze financial claims, chargebacks, invoice shortages, and disputes across business accounts. It transforms detailed financial records into actionable insights, helping teams understand claim activity, identify dispute drivers, track financial trends, and monitor recovered amounts.

Powered by Snowflake, the platform queries detailed and pre-aggregated datasets to generate account-specific and period-based analytics, including total claim and chargeback amounts, shortage trends, prior-period comparisons, dispute breakdowns, and recovery metrics. It also provides time-series data, category-based analytics, and paginated dispute records to support interactive dashboards and case-level investigation.

Core Capabilities:
- Snowflake Analytics: Query detailed and aggregated claim, chargeback, shortage, and dispute datasets.
- Financial Trend Reporting: Compare current and previous reporting periods and generate daily or period-based financial summaries.
- Dispute Analysis: Analyze claim types, dispute drivers, statuses, top records, and associated financial amounts.
- Recovery Insights: Track paid and approved amounts across relevant dispute categories.
- Account-Scoped Reporting: Filter analytics and dispute records by business account and reporting period.
- Dispute Management: Retrieve individual dispute records with pagination for detailed investigation.
- User and Access Administration: Manage users, organizations, roles, and role-based permissions.
- Authentication Workflows: Implement secure token-based authentication, token refresh, email verification, and password reset functionality.

Technical Overview:
The platform is developed using Python and Flask REST APIs, with Snowflake powering financial analytics and MySQL managing application data, including users, organizations, roles, permissions, and UI style settings. Implemented JWT-based authentication and authorization to secure API endpoints, with role-based permission checks for administrative operations. The application separates analytics and administration functionality through dedicated API endpoints, with Snowflake connectivity and query execution handled through a dedicated database module.

Tech Stack: Python, Flask, Flask-RESTful, Snowflake, MySQL, JWT.

projects.name: Third-Party API Integrations
projects.description:
Third-Party API Integrations — AI, Video Processing, Media Services, and Payment Solutions

Designed and implemented third-party API integrations to extend backend functionality and incorporate external services into application workflows. Integrated platforms such as OpenAI, Shotstack, Storyblocks, and Stripe to enable AI-powered capabilities, automated video creation, media asset retrieval, and secure online payment processing.

Key Capabilities:
- OpenAI Integration: Incorporate AI-powered features, intelligent content generation, and LLM-based functionality into backend applications.
- Shotstack Integration: Enable programmatic video creation, editing, and rendering workflows.
- Storyblocks Integration: Retrieve and manage stock videos and media assets through external APIs.
- Stripe Integration: Implement payment processing workflows, subscription management, and transaction handling.
- API Development: Build reusable backend services for external API communication and data exchange.
- Authentication and Security: Handle API credentials, authentication, and secure service communication.
- Error Handling: Implement request validation, response processing, and exception handling.
- Asynchronous Processing: Manage long-running API operations and resource-intensive workflows efficiently.

Technical Overview:
Developed backend integrations connecting external platforms with internal application services. Implemented API communication, authentication, request and response handling, payment workflows, and data processing to ensure reliable integration with AI, media, video processing, and payment service providers.

projects.name: CI/CD
projects.description: GitHub Action automates the Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipeline for deploying a Python application to an EC2 instance. It triggers on pushes to the main branch, sets up Python, configures SSH keys, and deploys the application to the specified EC2 host, updating it with the latest code from the repository. The action also sets up the necessary environment, database, and systemd service, and configures Nginx as a reverse proxy for the application.

projects.name: LocalAI
projects.description: Developed a local LLM chatbot API using LocalAI framework. LocalAI act as a drop-in replacement REST API that’s compatible with OpenAI API specifications for local inferencing. It allows you to run LLMs, generate images, audio (and not only) locally or on-prem with consumer grade hardware, supporting multiple model families and architectures. I used a publicly available LLM on huggingface.
